name: TSS writer 4 Vals
description: Write up to 4 values to the Time Series Service

inputs.label: tss_writer_url
inputs.description: URL of the TSS writer endpoint, e.g., http://localhost:8000/write

inputs.label: tags
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of tags to associate with the time series data, e.g., 'proof,experiment1'

inputs.label: valName_1
inputs.description: Name of the first value to be written to TSS, e.g., 'temperature'

inputs.label: valName_2
inputs.description: Name of the second value to be written to TSS, e.g., 'pressure'

inputs.label: valName_3
inputs.description: Name of the third value to be written to TSS, e.g., 'humidity'

inputs.label: valName_4
inputs.description: Name of the fourth value to be written to TSS, e.g., 'wind_speed'

inputs.label: timeUnit
inputs.description: Time unit for the timestamp to be written to TSS, e.g., 's' for seconds, 'ms' for milliseconds. Default is ms

inputs.label: resetInput
inputs.description: Whether to reset the value inputs to 0.0 after each write to TSS (true/false)

inputs.label: value_1
inputs.description: First value to be written to TSS at each SYNC, e.g., a temperature measurement. If resetInput is set to true, this value will be reset to 0.0 after each write to TSS.

inputs.label: value_2
inputs.description: Second value to be written to TSS at each SYNC, e.g., a pressure measurement. If resetInput is set to true, this value will be reset to 0.0 after each write to TSS.

inputs.label: value_3
inputs.description: Third value to be written to TSS at each SYNC, e.g., a humidity measurement. If resetInput is set to true, this value will be reset to 0.0 after each write to TSS.

inputs.label: value_4
inputs.description: Fourth value to be written to TSS at each SYNC, e.g., a wind speed measurement. If resetInput is set to true, this value will be reset to 0.0 after each write to TSS.

inputs.label: writeCP
inputs.description: Control parameter to trigger whether the cp is written to TSS, too

program.label: prog_tss_writer_4_values
program.description: post up to 4 values to the time series service TSS

attachments.label: attachment_tss_writer_4_values
attachments.description: write/post 4 values as time series data to the url of TSS
